method: Original isolated renders for homes and inventory 106 onward; temporary clone contact sheets for indices 6–105. Layout and content review only. Clone anomalies were checked against originals before being treated as findings. No live interaction implied.

observations.note: Circle creation already has illustration, people picker and three distinct settings. Current app source preserves these concepts.
Blank/transparent closed states are overlay animation states, not missing pages.
Lower Card content reaches behind persistent navigation in captured viewport; verify scrolling and bottom inset in prototype before flagging as clipping.
Card stack expanded/selected states are distinct interactive states, not separate production routes.
Shared Bills has overview/week tabs, contribution summary, list, import action and global plus. Do not replace with a generic list.
Long 12-contributor response list is visibly clipped by the fixed bottom action area; requires scrolling verification, not evidence of lost content.

Bill-resolution messaging is separately contextualized and says it does not change terms or authorize payments. Sent screen still visibly says 'Sent · prototype preview', conflicting with final-product copy guidance.

Distinct removal, keep-current-share, cancel-proposal, revised-share, accepted, scheduled and active states explicitly distinguish acceptance from payment and Circle membership from bill participation. Bottom actions are consistently anchored.
Confirmation, completed removal, and declined-revision views preserve prior activity and distinguish removal from the bill from Circle membership. No automatic redistribution is promised.

Contributor agreement, funding-account selection/review, cancellation and history are distinct views. Review names exact monthly amount, source, schedule and until-canceled authorization; cancellation preserves pending transfers and history. These states must not collapse into a generic account-setting screen.

Original isolated render visibly contains an unusually large blank card region between the Internet bill header and bank-account/continues rows; contribution amount and several agreement rows visible on Your agreement are absent. The bank-account value is cut off at the right edge. Check conditional visibility and original prototype state before treating this as an unconditional layout defect.
